deviations.claim_in_article: “The idea was that those carrying the cargo would repay the money the United States spends to keep the strait safe.”
deviations.issue: The article identifies cargo carriers as the payers, although the Ledger says the proposal did not specify who would be liable to pay.
deviations.explanation: It adds a specific payer and presents that detail as part of the proposal, despite HF-003 stating that the payer was unspecified. The Japanese source already contains this claim.

deviations.claim_in_article: “with its distant danger reaching gasoline prices and the cost of moving goods through crude oil.”
deviations.issue: The article asserts that the danger around the strait affects gasoline prices and the cost of moving goods through crude oil; the Ledger does not verify these downstream effects.
deviations.explanation: This adds a causal link to gasoline and goods-transport costs beyond the Ledger’s verified Brent-price movements and shipping concerns. The Japanese source already contains this claim.
